templates.home: Home: orient and route. Promise, three tier cards (tinted), proof, people, insights/resources, Get Started.
templates.tier-landing: Tier landing x3 (Tax Preparation, Business Accounting, Business & Tax Consulting): intro, service cards, who it is for / problems solved, people, related resources, Get Started. Territory accent.
templates.service-detail: One service, industry example or local page: eyebrow + title, who it is for, what we do, list, related, contextual Get Started. Inherits its tier accent.
templates.insight-article: Insight / article: the SEO carrier. Narrow reading column, headed sections, lists, related. Tagged with a tier (resource_tag).
templates.about-team: About / Team / Bio: firm story, team roster of portraits with bios (profile modules), reasons to choose the firm.
templates.client-resources: Client resources hub and pages: portal info, mobile app, what to bring, portal login link, forms. Also the proposed /resources/ hub.
templates.resource-media: Resource / media: article index, link index, video or guide with summary and download.
templates.get-started: Get Started intake, native Squarespace only: step 1 choice cards, step 2 one short Form block page per choice, step 3 thanks. Own closing, flow: true, tint shifts to the chosen tier.
templates.content-page: Extension beyond the plan's 8: plain page for contact, careers and legal pages (title banner, then text modules).
templates.contact: Contact: title banner, then a 7/5 split of the contact form and the office details (address, phone, fax, email, map link). Own closing (none added).

_about: Reliance CPA project copy of the Liftkit kit catalogue. Template names follow PROJECT_PLAN section 5 (home, tier-landing, service-detail, insight-article, about-team, client-resources, resource-media, get-started) plus content-page for contact/careers/legal. Layout families from the crawl are scaffold-based (S1 = long text page, S2 = short image+text) and say little about role, so every IN page is pinned in slug_overrides (generated by reliancecpa/tools/build_scope.py from tools/sitemap_data.py); family_to_template is only a fallback. Proposed pages (content/proposed/*.json) carry their own template. Module catalogue: see README.md in this folder (copied from liftkit/kit) and the 'project modules' section below.
